projectDescription: A WhatsApp AI chatbot that uses Flask webhooks and the Groq LLM (LLaMA 3) to answer user questions based on a structured knowledge base.
keyFeatures: WhatsApp Business API webhook integration via Flask
Fuzzy-matching context retrieval from a JSON knowledge base
Groq LLM (LLaMA 3 8B) powered natural language responses
Lightweight university assistant persona with configurable context
Simple single-file architecture easy to self-host
publicApiSurface: POST /webhook — Receives incoming WhatsApp messages and dispatches AI responses
manejar_query(mensaje_usuario) — Orchestrates context lookup and LLM response generation
buscar_contexto(pregunta_usuario) — Fuzzy-searches the knowledge base for the closest matching answer
consultar_llm(contexto, pregunta) — Sends context + question to the Groq API and returns the LLM answer
enviar_mensaje(numero, texto) — Sends a WhatsApp text message via the Business API
